name: Breadcrumb
intent: Path to the current page as a trail of links.
usage: Use Breadcrumb above a page title to show where the page sits in the app. The last crumb is the current page and is never a link. Slash is the default separator; chevron is the alternate. Long trails collapse with maxItems. See contracts/breadcrumb.json for the full contract.

maxItems.note: When items.length > maxItems: first crumb, an ellipsis, then the last maxItems - 1 crumbs.

items.note: Two or more. The last item is the current page; its href is ignored. onClick makes a crumb a button for in-app navigation.

current.note: The last item is the current page (not a link). false keeps every crumb a link, for a trail of parent sections above a page title, like PageHeader.

useWhen: Show where a page sits in the app, above its title.
Detail pages inside a list, like Invoices / INV-1042.
doNot: Do not invent a local Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem or BreadcrumbLink.
Do not make the current page a link.
Do not use Breadcrumb as the sidebar or as tabs.
Do not put a menu on the ellipsis. It is visual only.
Do not mix separators in one app.
a11y: nav with aria-label=Breadcrumb around an ordered list.
The current page has aria-current=page and is not a link.
Separators and the ellipsis are aria-hidden.
Links and buttons show a focus ring.
snippet: <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Home", href: "/" }, { label: "Invoices", href: "/invoices" }, { label: "INV-1042" }]} />

examples.title: Slash
examples.usage: The default. Ancestors link; the current page does not.

examples.title: Chevron
examples.usage: The alternate separator. Use one separator style across the app.

examples.title: Collapsed
examples.usage: For long trails, maxItems shows the first crumb, an ellipsis, then the last crumbs. The ellipsis is visual only, not a menu.
